newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to privatise Thomson in stages - decree.
newsitem.headline: France to privatise Thomson in stages - decree.

text.p: The French government will privatise electronics group Thomson SA in stages, beginning with the transfer to the private sector of Thomson's majority stake in Thomson-CSF, the government's official journal reported on Thursday.

"It has been decided to proceed with a transfer of Thomson SA to the private sector...in stages, the first being the transfer to the private sector of the majority stake held by Thomson SA in Thomson-CSF's capital," the Journal Officiel said.
Thomson SA, wholly owned by the state, owns 58 percent of defence electronics firm Thomson-CSF.
The government earlier this month relaunched the privatisation process, announcing its intention to privatise Thomson-CSF through a private placement.

Last year it cancelled its original plan to sell all of Thomson to the Lagardere Group after the independent Privatisation Commission objected to the terms of the planned sale by Lagardere of consumer electronics unit Thomson Multimedia (TMM) to Daewoo Electronics.
The government subsequently said it would sell Thomson's two businesses, Thomson-CSF and money-losing TMM, separately.
